newsitem.title: USA: Negative focus on munis hurts industry - lobbyist.
newsitem.headline: Negative focus on munis hurts industry - lobbyist.

text.p: The negative publicity focused on the municipal bond market in recent months could severly hurt the industry in the future, a bond lobbyist said Thursday.
Micah Green, executive vice president with Public Securities Association, said the negative focus "will affect the ability to promote the mission of what municipals do" before Congress.
Green, speaking at a conference here sponsored by Grant's Municipal Bond Observer, was referring to a number of investigations by both federal and state officials into the industry.
He said that "there are imperfections everywhere," but that the industry has worked to fix its problems.
Green noted, for example, that the industry has come a long way in developing disclosure and price transparency practices.
